title: Reading Mini Test 01 – Office Life
description: Đề rút gọn 11 câu bao phủ đủ 3 Part của phần Reading: điền từ vào câu, hoàn thành đoạn văn và đọc hiểu.

questions.content: The quarterly report must be ------- to the finance department by Friday.
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc bị động với động từ khuyết thiếu: must be + V3 → "submitted".

questions.content: Ms. Tanaka has worked at the Osaka branch ------- 2019.
questions.explanation: Thì hiện tại hoàn thành + mốc thời gian (2019) → dùng "since".

questions.content: Please read the safety instructions ------- before operating the machine.
questions.explanation: Cần trạng từ bổ nghĩa cho động từ "read" → "carefully".

questions.content: The new software is ------- with most operating systems.
questions.explanation: "compatible with" = tương thích với. "comparable" đi với "to", không hợp nghĩa.

groups.passage:
To: All staff
From: Facilities Management
Subject: Parking lot repairs

Dear employees,

The east parking lot will be closed for repairs from Monday, June 3, to Friday, June 7. During this time, employees ---131--- in the west lot or on Harbor Street. ---132---.

We apologize for any ---133--- this may cause. The work is expected to improve drainage and lighting, ---134--- the lot safer for everyone.

Thank you for your understanding.

questions.explanation: Chủ ngữ "employees" cần một động từ chính mang nghĩa khuyên/yêu cầu → "should park".

options.A: The west lot opens at 6:30 a.m.

questions.explanation: Câu chèn phải liên quan tới việc đỗ xe ở bãi phía tây vừa nhắc → (A).
Sau "any" cần danh từ → "inconvenience" (sự bất tiện).
Mệnh đề rút gọn chỉ kết quả sau dấu phẩy → V-ing "making".

groups.passage:
Green Leaf Café – Now Open in Riverside Mall

Enjoy freshly roasted coffee, homemade pastries, and light lunches. Open daily from 7 a.m. to 8 p.m.

Show this advertisement before June 30 to receive 20% off any drink.

Free Wi-Fi and a meeting space for groups of up to 10 people are available. Reservations for the meeting space are recommended.

questions.explanation: "Green Leaf Café – Now Open" → một quán cà phê mới mở.

questions.content: How can customers receive a discount?
questions.explanation: "Show this advertisement before June 30 to receive 20% off".

questions.content: What is suggested about the meeting space?

options.A: It is free of charge on weekends.
options.B: It should be reserved in advance.
options.C: It can hold more than 20 people.

questions.explanation: "Reservations for the meeting space are recommended" → nên đặt trước.
